title: Contextual Path Retrieval via Entity Relation Embeddings
summary: This community centers on the 2023 paper 'Contextual Path Retrieval: A Contextual Entity Relation Embedding-based Approach' published in ACM Transactions on Information Systems. The work is authored by Pei-Chi Lo and Ee-Peng Lim and focuses on leveraging contextual entity relation embeddings to improve retrieval processes. It represents a specific methodological contribution to the field of information systems and knowledge graph retrieval.
key_findings: The paper 'Contextual Path Retrieval: A Contextual Entity Relation Embedding-based Approach' was published in ACM Trans. Inf. Syst. in 2023.
The authors of the paper are Pei-Chi Lo and Ee-Peng Lim.
The publication is cited as ACM Trans. Inf. Syst. 41, 1 (2023), 1:1–1:38.
The approach specifically utilizes contextual entity relation embeddings for path retrieval.
The work is situated within the broader context of information retrieval and natural language processing research, as indicated by its publication venue and citation context.
